name: Tasmanian Aboriginal (Palawa)
notes: A genuinely distinct case from the mainland groups researched in this batch: British colonization produced a catastrophic, more totalizing disruption (the 1825-1831 "Black War," internment at Wybalenna 1833-1847) than most mainland cases. Pre-contact population estimates are themselves scholarly-disputed (see claim_tasmania_black_war_wybalenna_disputed). Surviving religious/cosmological content is reconstructable only in fragments from colonially-filtered 19th-century ethnohistoric records — no GenderSystem entity is modeled for this culture in this batch, since no agent in this research round specifically investigated Tasmanian gender/kinship organization and the evidentiary base for such a record was not established; better to leave the gap explicit than fabricate dimensions from unresearched material.
